summary: Photo-mode vignette (client only; registry total 24 on the client row). Written by ecl::photo_mode::VignetteSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x7672D0, apply step bg3.exe+0x1B07560) from its pending ls::Optional<VignetteRequest>, filled by VignetteSystem::LEGACY_UpdateVignette(bool, Vector3f, float, float) from the photo-mode UI (NoesisGameUI.dll+0x71E170: selected vignette's colour, VignetteIntensity, VignettePower). Never seen alive.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B07560: stride 0x18; compares/copies byte +0 with request+0 (LEGACY_UpdateVignette param 1). The UI passes `selectedVignette+0x70 == 0` (a flag of the selected vignette entry, probably 'is the None entry').

fields.name: Color
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B07560 compares floats +4,+8,+0xC as a squared distance (vector) with request+4..+0xC (LEGACY_UpdateVignette's Vector3f, copied as 8+4 bytes); the UI takes the three floats at selectedVignette+0x60..0x68 (the vignette resource's colour, cf. SE PhotoModeVignette.Color).

fields.name: Intensity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B07560 compares/copies float +0x10; the UI passes VM +0x998 whose symbol 'VignetteIntensity' sits at +0x99C (NoesisGameUI.dll+0x715A00); request default 1.0 (0x3f800000).

fields.name: Power
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B07560 compares/copies float +0x14; the UI passes VM +0x9B0 whose symbol 'VignettePower' sits at +0x9B4; request default 10.0 (0x41200000). macOS default constructor stores one 8-byte value at +0x10 (both floats) and zeroes +0..+0xF.
